changeSet.author: dimopoulosc
changeSet.comment: Add auto send claim invitation enabled flag column to compliant entity table
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE "compliant_entity" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "auto_send_claim_invitation_enabled" BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE; COMMENT ON COLUMN "compliant_entity"."auto_send_claim_invitation_enabled" IS 'A flag that indicates whether automatic Account Claim invitations are enabled for this account.';

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE "compliant_entity" DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS "auto_send_claim_invitation_enabled";

changeSet.author: dimopoulosc
changeSet.comment: Add invitation status column to mets account contacts.
changeSet.sql: alter table mets_account_contact add column if not exists invitation_status boolean default true;

rollback.sql: alter table mets_account_contact drop column if exists invitation_status;

changeSet.author: dimopoulosc
changeSet.comment: Add invitation status column to account representative invitations.
changeSet.sql: alter table account_representative_invitation add column if not exists invitation_status boolean default true;

rollback.sql: alter table account_representative_invitation drop column if exists invitation_status;

changeSet.author: dimopoulosc
changeSet.comment: Add an entry in account_representative_invitation table for not yet invited registry contacts.
changeSet.sql: insert into account_representative_invitation (id, account_id, account_holder_representative_id, invitation_status) select nextval('account_rep_inv_seq'),a.id,ahr.id,true from account a inner join account_holder ah on a.account_holder_id = ah.id inner join account_holder_representative ahr on ah.id=ahr.account_holder_id inner join contact c on ahr.contact_id = c.id where a.registry_account_type in ('AIRCRAFT_OPERATOR_HOLDING_ACCOUNT','MARITIME_OPERATOR_HOLDING_ACCOUNT','OPERATOR_HOLDING_ACCOUNT') and not exists (select 1 from account_representative_invitation ari where ari.account_id = a.id and ari.account_holder_representative_id =ahr.id)

rollback.sql: delete from account_representative_invitation ari where ari.invitation_status = true and ari.invited_date is null and exists ( select 1 from account a join account_holder ah on a.account_holder_id = ah.id join account_holder_representative ahr on ah.id = ahr.account_holder_id where ari.account_id = a.id and ari.account_holder_representative_id = ahr.id and a.registry_account_type in ( 'AIRCRAFT_OPERATOR_HOLDING_ACCOUNT', 'MARITIME_OPERATOR_HOLDING_ACCOUNT', 'OPERATOR_HOLDING_ACCOUNT' ) );

changeSet.author: dimopoulosc
changeSet.comment: Add first_add_ar_created and first_add_ar_approved column to account metrics.
changeSet.sql: alter table reporting_metrics.account_metrics add column if not exists first_add_ar_created timestamp; alter table reporting_metrics.account_metrics add column if not exists first_add_ar_approved timestamp;

rollback.sql: alter table reporting_metrics.account_metrics drop column if exists first_add_ar_created; alter table reporting_metrics.account_metrics drop column if exists first_add_ar_approved;

changeSet.comment: Add first_invitation_date and last_invitation_sent columns to account metrics.
changeSet.sql: alter table reporting_metrics.account_metrics add column if not exists last_invitation_sent timestamp; alter table reporting_metrics.account_metrics add column if not exists first_invitation_date timestamp;
